_notes.teams: League size. Used for par and for the snake draft order.
_notes.rounds: Roster spots per team (13 x 10 teams = 130 drafted players).
_notes.pool: z-scores use the mean and spread of the top N players by projected rank.
_notes.first_rounds: How many early picks count as 'the first four'.
_notes.reach: Max picks past a player's ADP you may take him (first four and later picks).
_notes.first_four_exclude: Names that may NOT be picked in the first picks (still allowed later). Must match names in data/players.json exactly.
